angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 1,033,810 km at 1016.03 pc = 0.01 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 0.9842 +/- 0.0105 mas (same row, RUWE 0.96): 1016.03 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.486 +/- 0.053 solar radii from Esteves et al. 2015, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of Kepler-8 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015ApJ...804..150E/abstract): 1,033,810 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.213 +/- 0.067 solar masses from Esteves et al. 2015, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of Kepler-8 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015ApJ...804..150E/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6213 +/- 150 K from Esteves et al. 2015, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of Kepler-8 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015ApJ...804..150E/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Esteves et al. 2015, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of Kepler-8 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015ApJ...804..150E/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/kepler-8.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.178, rounded to two decimals
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, Kepler-8: main object type *, Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of Kepler-8 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.055 dex, from Esteves et al. 2015 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015ApJ...804..150E/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of Kepler-8 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.605, from Jenkins et al. 2010 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2010ApJ...724.1108J/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of Kepler-8 (pscomppars): age 3.47 Gyr, from Morton et al. 2016 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016ApJ...822...86M/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of Kepler-8 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 10.5 km/s, from Bonomo et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
